column_description: BIGSERIAL. Unique identifier for each light and radiation reading. PK.
TEXT. Reference to the environmental reading. FK to EnvironmentalReadingsCore.monitor_code.
BIGINT. Light intensity in lux. Example: 138.0.
REAL. Ultraviolet (UV) radiation in microwatts. Example: 32.58.
REAL. Infrared radiation in watts. Example: 7.51.
BIGINT. Visible light intensity in lux-hours. Example: 71166.
